include_directories(${REACTOS_SOURCE_DIR}/ntoskrnl/include)

# The usbohci .c bodies (roothub/usbohci) are replaced by Rust (usbohci-rust,
# libusbohci_rust.a). The .c files are kept on disk per the never-delete rule. guid.c stays
# compiled as a data-only TU (DEFINE_GUID). Bar: link-clean x3 (NOT boot-loaded in smoke).

# usbohci.sys is all Rust (usbohci-rust) and cargo links it:
# sdk/lib/rust/usbohci-cargo (reactos-link, generated by tools/cargo_cell_gen.py).
# The C stays on disk, uncompiled.
# The C still compiled, in an OBJECT library whose compile the cargo link replays.
add_cargo_module(usbohci usbohci-cargo usbohci.sys
    KIND kernelmodedriver
    BODY_CRATE usbohci-rust
    DESTINATION reactos/system32/drivers
    NO_CAB
    EXTRA_DEPENDS psdk libusbport libusbd libhal libntoskrnl)
